result.analyst_notes: Factual, business-led tone: opens with scale and capability claims and describes operations. Uses first-person plural 'we' and mostly absolute language ('committed'). Values are sparse; social posts add DEI and environment items. Customers, employees and integrity go unaddressed. 'Challenged with an important job' is distinctive wording.
